name: Ring of Disease Detection
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Price 10,800 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This ring is forged from copper, with swirling designs decorating the outside of the band. With a touch, the wearer of this ring can determine if a creature is carrying a disease, and discern more details about the illness, as with the spell detect disease.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Forge Ring, detect disease; Cost 5,400 gp.
